title: 8 Clear Fridge & Pantry Organizers for a Stress-Free January Reset
metaDescription: Stop losing groceries in the back of the fridge. These 8 clear, stackable fridge and pantry organizers make your January kitchen reset effortless.

faqs.q: What is the best order to organize a refrigerator during a January reset?
faqs.a: Empty one shelf at a time, wipe it down, group items by category (drinks, breakfast, condiments, produce), and place clear bins by expiration priority so older items stay in front.

faqs.q: Should you decant every dry food item in a small pantry?
faqs.a: Focus on staples you buy repeatedly (flour, sugar, oats, rice, pasta, coffee) and keep boxed snacks in open clear bins so restocking stays fast.
